summary: November 9, 2026 briefing compared with November 6. Mega Greninja ex League Battle Deck retains a November 13 manufacturer release date, without a verified retailer opening hour. Delta Reign preorder shipment estimates remain mid-November. Walmart's November 4 drawings and November 7 result deadline are past; no fresh dated entry window was verified. Nine checked Target listings remain out of stock. Sam's terms now show a November 6 revision date, but the prior edition lacks a full text snapshot to attribute a substantive purchase-rule change. No newly introduced limit or checkout-rule change established for November 2–9. Costco bundle reports remain separate rumors; signed-in and local stock coverage is limited.

retailers.coverage: Nine product pages, preorder help and terms rechecked against November 6. Prices, identifiers and out-of-stock/final-sale status agree; November 6 street dates are now historical. No new dated opening, numeric cap or local allocation verified. No signed-in checkout. Coverage focuses on these Pokémon listings, not an exhaustive TCG catalog.

confirmed.title: Drawing and aggregated quantity baseline
confirmed.details: Account required; free entry once per drawing. Address, payment and quantity lock at entry, which cannot be canceled. Selection automatically places an order subject to processing; existing cart cannot combine. General caps may aggregate person, household, order, account, payment and address. Drawing orders below $35 may incur delivery fees; existing-cart items cannot be added to meet the threshold.
confirmed.planningImpact: Confirm details before entry; profile counts do not expand the permitted household allowance. Rules match prior coverage.
checks: Verify event-specific eligibility/cap and any Walmart+ requirement; no universal Walmart+ requirement verified.
